[[Rob Lanier]] |stadium=[[O'Connell Center]] |champion=Legends Classic Champions |bowl= [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result=Round of 64 }} {{2009–10 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2009–10 Florida Gators men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Florida]] in the sport of [[basketball]] during the [[2009–10 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2009–10 college basketball season]]. The Gators competed in [[Division I (NCAA)|Division I]] of the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association]] (NCAA) and the Eastern Division of the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). They were led by head coach [[Billy Donovan]], and played their home games in the [[O'Connell Center]] on the university's [[Gainesville, Florida]] campus. The Gators finished the season 21–13, 9–7 in SEC play. They advanced to the quarterfinals of the [[2010 SEC men's basketball tournament]] before losing to [[2009–10 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]]. They received an at–large bid to the [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], their first appearance since their [[2006–07 Florida Gators men's basketball team|2006–07 National Championship season]], where they earned a No. 10 seed in the West Region.
